latest.notes: Settings is reorganised: eight groups instead of one long list, ordered by what you're looking for — Station, Programming, Audio, Incoming, On Air, Remote, Data, App. External, FTP, Online, URL and Auto-Import are now a single Audio Sources pane with a picker. A search field finds a pane by name or by what it does, so 'gpio' finds Triggers and 'icecast' finds Streaming.
